defaults.label: Frontier Village
defaults.name: Frontier Village
defaults.description: A humble settlement nestled at the edge of civilization. The locals are wary of strangers but willing to trade with those who prove their worth.

coordinates.name: Havenbrook
coordinates.description: A peaceful farming village nestled in a sheltered valley north of the central rift. Known for its annual harvest festival and the finest ale in the realm. The villagers are welcoming but wary of the darkness creeping from the south.
coordinates.flavorText: Home is where the hearth burns bright.

coordinates.name: Willowmere
coordinates.description: A village of herbalists and healers built around a crystal-clear spring said to possess restorative properties. Pilgrims travel from across the realm to drink from Willowmere's waters and seek cures for ailments mundane and magical.
coordinates.flavorText: Nature provides for those who listen.

coordinates.name: Thornfield
coordinates.description: A rugged frontier settlement populated by hunters, trappers, and rangers. Thornfield sits at the edge of wild territory, and its residents are as tough as the thorny hedgerows that form the village's natural walls.

coordinates.name: Ashvale
coordinates.description: A mining settlement built into the foothills south of the central darkness. Ashvale's miners extract rare ores from veins that glow with residual dark energy. The work is dangerous but incredibly lucrative.
coordinates.flavorText: Dig deep enough and you'll find either fortune or doom.
